acceptance_criterion: Accept transfer of the E1 coefficient to the E2 reactive-core baseline if the arithmetic-mean SI_15_60 is between 7.51% and 11.51%, inclusive, corresponding to the H-CORE prediction of 9.51% within the declared 2.00-percentage-point resolution.
claim_boundary: V4.0.0 selects an experiment from pre-result evidence under an outcome-blind runtime. Its adjudication tests whether a registered hypothesis survives contact with the completed measurement. It is not a contemporaneous pre-experimental record and does not claim that the historical decision used this ranking.

experiment_card.acceptance_criterion: Matched 15-60 min drift at 120 C stays below 4.75% across at least two repeats, i.e. below half the linear-dilution prediction of 9.51% implied by a reactive mass fraction of 1.0000. This accepts H-RESIN over H-CORE.
experiment_card.falsification_criterion: H-RESIN is falsified if matched 15-60 min drift is at or above the linear-dilution prediction of 9.51%. H-CORE is falsified if drift falls below 4.75%, a separation larger than the 2.00% resolution threshold. H-DUAL is falsified if this acrylic-only composition reaches the low-drift regime with no minor tackifier present.

measurement_plan.name: matched-window 120 C thermal hold
measurement_plan.protocol: Hold the melt at 120 C. Record viscosity at 15, 30, 45 and 60 min. Report the 15-60 min matched-window relative change. Run at least two independent repeats.

falsification_criterion: If arithmetic-mean SI_15_60 is below 7.51%, falsify H-CORE's registered linear prediction for the E2 core because drift is more than 2.00 percentage points below 9.51%. A mean from 7.51% through 11.51% falsifies none of H-CORE, H-RESIN, or H-DUAL. A mean above 11.51% rejects numerical transfer of the 9.51% coefficient but does not meet H-CORE's registered directional falsification condition; no outcome from this modifier-free control can falsify H-RESIN or H-DUAL.
next_experiment_if_falsified: Run S1C49::M-HOLD-120 with the same controlled process history and repeat aggregation, using the measured E2 mean drift—not E1's 9.51%—to preregister the S1C49 linear prediction as 0.80 × E2 mean and the strong-suppression threshold as 0.40 × E2 mean; first verify whether the acrylic contributes NCO-reactive functionality.
primary_observable: Arithmetic mean across at least two independent preparations of SI_15_60 = 100 × (eta_60 - eta_15) / eta_15 at 120 C; retain each preparation's eta_15 and repeat-level SI_15_60.
rationale: S1C01::M-HOLD-120 is the defensible control needed before interpreting acrylic-induced drift suppression. It directly measures the least-resolved isothermal-time coordinate, stays within measured support, preregisters repeat aggregation and numerical thresholds, and makes only a formulation-level rheological claim.
stage_disagreements_resolved: Followed the Skeptic and Robustness Adjudicator rather than the Proposer. The Proposer's S1C49 acrylic-only probe directly targets the failure mode, but its central 7.608% comparator imports a single-run E1 drift coefficient into an E2-based formulation without an E2 hold baseline. Measuring S1C01 first removes that formulation-baseline ambiguity. S1C01 was chosen as the canonical entry among S1C01-S1C09, which are apparently composition-identical; the withheld deterministic ranking cannot resolve that tie.

uncertainty_decomposition.evidence_coverage_uncertainty: No prior E2 thermal-hold trajectory exists, so this experiment fills the principal baseline gap. It contains no resin modifier and therefore cannot adjudicate resin suppression or tackifier necessity.
uncertainty_decomposition.extrapolation_uncertainty: The test remains at the locally observed 120 C temperature and 15-60 min window, so temporal and temperature extrapolation are avoided. Transfer from E1 to the compositionally distinct E2 core is precisely the assumption being checked.
uncertainty_decomposition.measurement_uncertainty: M-HOLD-120 has a declared 2.00-percentage-point discrimination threshold. Use the preregistered arithmetic mean of at least two independent repeat-level SI_15_60 values; the single E1 reference run remains an additional uncertainty in coefficient transfer.
uncertainty_decomposition.realization_state_uncertainty: E2 previously showed approximately 2.80-3.57-fold viscosity-scale variation between preparations. Fully record and control process history and retain eta_15 for every preparation; this card measures whether matched-window drift is transferable despite that starting-state variation.

voi.formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk. Every component is normalized to [0, 1] by construction. This is a transparent normalized score with reported weight sensitivity, not a Bayesian posterior.
